Warm pale parchment studio wash, restrained warm color response, soft grounding shadow, no environmental story.

Face: broad oval face; high cheekbones and softly lidded eyes; broad low bridge, full lips; subtle age lines. Calm closed-mouth neutral expression with no smile, grin, or theatrical acting.

Hair: multicolor-split-streak, asymmetric-extreme, deliberate accent: dramatic contrasting side length. Wardrobe: asymmetric-patchwork, specifically intentional patchwork layers with an uneven hem, visible repairs, and practical trousers; a divided hem and broad folded collar; bounded palette indigo-sand. Visible personal details: no accessory and no tattoo. Make stitching, quilting, embroidery, or woven pattern the primary recognition device. Maintenance cue: practical grooming with one carefully perfected detail. Color treatment: keeps color restrained to layered edges. Pose cue: one shoulder leads subtly and the gaze meets the viewer without a smile. Include a worn spool of colored thread only as a quiet personal object, never as a weapon.

This is ordinary but intentionally designed 1-star mortal clothing. No weapon, armor, crown, magic, aura, or glow.
